scripts.dev: concurrently -n marketing,campus -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:marketing" "npm run dev:campus"
scripts.build: npm run build:marketing && npm run build:campus
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:marketing && npm run typecheck:campus
scripts.check:size: size-limit || echo AVISO: el bundle supero el techo de .size-limit.json (no bloquea)
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:secrets && npm run check:arch
scripts.check:task: npm run check:fast && npm run typecheck
scripts.check:full: npm run check:task && npm run build && npm run check:size && gitleaks git --redact --no-banner
